name: Streaked Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern china (liaoning to hubei); winters in philippines
description: A mysterious and secretive reed warbler; formerly fairly common but now increasingly rare and possibly near extinction. The only Asian reed warbler with a streaked crown and back.

name: White-throated Kingbird
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela and the guianas to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Large flycatcher that occupies a variety of habitats, from forest edges to open areas and pastures, to woodlands and urban areas; can appear almost anywhere on migration. It has a light gray head contrasting with a dark mask and white throat.

name: Collared Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Eastern france to balkans and ukraine; winters in tropical and southern africa
description: Males are striking black-and-white flycatchers with a conspicuous complete white collar, all dark tail, and white rump. Females can be difficult to separate from other flycatchers but have a large white primary patch on the wing.

name: Cinereous Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Locally in campos of south-central brazil
description: Small, compact finch. Gray above, paler below; note the fairly well-defined dark mask.

name: Sapphire-bellied Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Coastal north-central colombia
description: Rare, endangered, and poorly known hummingbird restricted to mangroves and adjacent scrubby areas along the Colombian coast. Male has sapphire underparts extending from throat all the way to belly, and lacks the distinct hood typical of the more common Sapphire-throated Hummingbird.

name: Zapata Wren
rangeDescription: Southwestern cuba (dense vegetation of zapata swamp)
description: A highly secretive denizen of sawgrass marshes. This small brown bird, with heavy barring above, and a somewhat long, down-curved bill has no similar species within its range.

name: Writhed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (camiguin, dinagat, and mindanao)
description: A large bird of lowland forest on Mindanao and neighboring islands. Mostly black with a black-tipped white tail, a red casque and bill with ridges on the lower base, and orange bare skin around the eye and chin pouch.

name: Malabar Woodshrike
rangeDescription: Southwestern india (western ghats from narbada river to kerala)
description: Large, dark woodshrike with ashy gray upperparts and darker gray wing panel and tail with a variable brownish tinge. A prominent black face mask surrounds the pale yellow iris.

name: Baikal Teal
rangeDescription: Breeds in northern and eastern siberia; winters japan, korea, and eastern china
description: Males is exquisitely patterned, with an unmistakable green-and-yellow facial pattern, spotted rose-pink breast, and long, drooping scapulars. Female mostly drab brown but with a distinct white spot near the bill base as well as a very weak hint of the male's facial pattern.

name: Palau Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Palau (babelthuap, koror, garakayo, peleliu, and ngabad)
description: A large dull-colored warbler with a long bright orange bill and orange legs. Olive-brown above, greenish or yellowish buff below.

name: Bachman's Warbler
rangeDescription: Formerly southeastern usa; wintered to cuba and bahamas (probably extinct)
description: Jewel of a warbler, probably extinct. Male is distinctive, with a black patch on the lower throat and chest.

name: Christmas Island-Thrush
rangeDescription: Christmas island (indian ocean)
description: Brown and gray thrush with an orange belly, pale throat, and bright orange bill, eyering, legs, and feet. Inhabits forested habitats across Christmas Island, where it can sometimes be found quite close to human habitation; the only resident thrush on the island, and unmistakable.

name: Spot-winged Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern pakistan to southern tibet, southwestern china, myanmar, and thailand
description: A large, heavy-billed finch. Male is black above and yellow below with white streaks and spots on the wings.

name: Black-backed Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Boreal forest of northern north america
description: Dark woodpecker, inconspicuous and uncommon. Found in coniferous forests, often in recently burned areas or bogs with many dead trees.

name: White-breasted Guineafowl
rangeDescription: Upper guinea forest of southeastern sierra leone to ivory coast and western ghana
description: Small, long-tailed, mostly black guineafowl with a white ruff around the neck and a bare red head. Found on the ground in lowland rainforest.

name: Buff-breasted Tody-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Lowlands of eastern brazil (ceará, pernambuco, and alagoas)
description: Unobtrusive, drab little brownish flycatcher. Olive-backed, pale below, with the head looking disproportionately large compared to the rest of the body.

name: Iraq Babbler
rangeDescription: Southern türkiye, syria, iraq, and southwestern iran (reedbeds of tigris-euphrates valley)
description: Small babbler with a long tail and short wings, typical of other babblers. Warm buff overall with a pale throat and a lightly streaked back and crown.

name: Gray-throated Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southwestern philippines (balabac, busuanga, calamianes, and palawan)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland and foothill forest and edge on Palawan and neighboring islands. Yellow below with an olive-green back, brown wings and tail, a gray cheek, and a white throat.

name: Pileated Parrot
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Fairly small parrot usually seen in small groups or pairs in the canopy of humid forests, including Araucaria forests. The body is mostly green apart from a blue outer wing and tail feathers.

name: Claudia's Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china to eastern tibet; winters to southern china and southeastern asia
description: One of the Blyth’s-type warblers, this species regularly flicks its wings one after the other. Usually forages actively high up in the canopy, clambering along branches.
